Cookout Menu: How to Create the Perfect Outdoor Feast with the Best Deals

When it comes to outdoor feasts, nothing quite matches the excitement of a cookout. The smell of sizzling burgers, the tang of BBQ sauce, and the refreshing satisfaction of a milkshake are enough to make any summer day memorable. If you’re planning to host the ultimate cookout and want to make sure you get the best deals, then this guide will walk you through everything from setting the perfect cookout menu to choosing the best restaurant deals.

Cookout Menu with Prices\

To make your cookout a hit, it’s essential to have a wide variety of food items that will please everyone. From burgers to chicken strips and fancy milkshakes, here is an updated list of the most popular items from the cookout menu:

Menu Item Price Description
Big Double Burger $4.99 Two char-grilled patties with cheddar cheese
Char-Grilled Chicken Breast $5.49 Tender chicken breast grilled to perfection
2 Hot Dogs $3.99 Two hot dogs with your choice of toppings
Spicy Chicken Sandwich $4.29 Crispy spicy chicken served with lettuce
Quesadillas (Chicken or Beef) $3.99 Soft tortillas filled with melted cheese
Cheesecake $2.99 Creamy cheesecake with various flavors
Milkshake (Multiple Flavors) $2.89 Fancy milkshakes with flavors like Oreo, banana
Cajun Fries $2.29 Crispy fries seasoned with Cajun spices
Corn Dog $2.49 Classic corn dog perfect for kids and adults
Crispy Chicken Wrap $4.49 A wrap stuffed with crispy chicken and veggies
Cheerwine Soda $1.99 A southern favorite soft drink
Hushpuppies $1.79 Classic Southern fried dough balls
BBQ Sandwich $3.99 Tangy pulled pork with slaw on a toasted bun

These prices are updated, and it’s best to check with your local Cookout restaurant for the latest deals, as prices and availability may vary.

Popular Cookout Menu Items

When it comes to must-have items at your cookout, there are several that stand out as perennial favorites.

Burgers

No cookout menu is complete without burgers. The Big Double Burger is one of the most popular options, with two char-grilled patties, cheddar cheese, and a side of crispy fries. You can also customize your burger with grilled onions, BBQ sauce, or cheddar style toppings for an extra burst of flavor.

Hot Dogs

For a more traditional cookout experience, the 2 Hot Dogs option is a crowd-pleaser. They come with a variety of toppings like ketchup, mustard, and slaw, allowing you to make each one your own.

Chicken Options

For those who prefer chicken, crispy chicken wraps or a char-grilled chicken breast sandwich are excellent choices. The crispy chicken is especially popular for its crunch and tangy flavor, while the spicy chicken offers a kick with Cajun seasoning.

Cookout Tray Menu

One of the best deals you can find on a cookout menu is the Cookout Tray, which allows you to mix and match various menu items to create the perfect meal. For one flat price (usually between $5.99 and $6.99), you can choose one main item, two sides, and a drink. Here’s a breakdown:

Main Items for Cookout Tray:

  • Big Double Burger
  • Chicken Quesadilla
  • 2 Hot Dogs
  • BBQ Sandwich
  • Spicy Chicken

Sides Menu for Cookout Tray:

  • Cajun Fries
  • Onion Rings
  • Hushpuppies
  • Chicken Strips
  • Cheese Bites

Cookout Drinks Menu:

  • Cheerwine
  • Freshly Brewed Tea
  • Fancy Milkshakes
  • Coke Products

This Cookout Tray is one of the most affordable and customizable options at the Cookout restaurant, giving you a lot of value for your money.

Fancy Milkshake Menu

What’s a cookout without a refreshing shake to wash down your meal? The Cookout Milkshake Menu is filled with over 40 flavors, ranging from classic vanilla to more exotic ones like banana pudding and Oreo. Some popular flavors include:

Flavor Description Price
Oreo Classic shake with crushed Oreo cookies blended into vanilla ice cream $2.89
Banana Pudding Creamy banana-flavored shake with chunks of banana and pudding $2.89
Mint Chocolate Chip Refreshing mint shake with chocolate chips swirled in $2.89
Chocolate Cheesecake Rich chocolate shake combined with a smooth cheesecake flavor $2.89
Peanut Butter Fudge A decadent mix of peanut butter and rich fudge $2.89

These shakes are thick and satisfying, perfect for cooling off on a hot day or as a dessert after your meal. And at $2.89, they are a great value!

BBQ Options

If you’re a BBQ lover, then you’ll want to check out the BBQ menu at Cookout. From their BBQ Sandwich to BBQ sauce-drenched burgers, you’ll find all the smoky, tangy flavors that make for a great outdoor feast. The BBQ sauce has a slightly tangy and sweet flavor, which complements the char-grilled hamburgers and pulled pork sandwiches beautifully.

Sides Menu

No cookout is complete without sides! At Cookout, there’s a wide selection of sides to complement your meal, whether you’re ordering from the tray menu or a la carte. Some of the most popular side items include:

  • Cajun Fries – Spiced with Cajun seasoning for extra flavor
  • Hushpuppies – Perfectly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside
  • Cheese Bites – Little nuggets of gooey white cheddar cheese
  • Onion Rings – Battered and fried to golden perfection

These sides are great for adding variety to your meal and come at reasonable prices ranging from $1.79 to $2.49.

Cookout Restaurant Experience

The experience at a Cookout restaurant is what makes it so appealing to fast food lovers. Cookout offers both delivery and pickup options, allowing you to enjoy your favorite meals from the comfort of your home or during your outdoor feast.

Order Cookout for Delivery or Pickup

You can order from Cookout through their website or through various delivery apps. The delivery fee is usually nominal, and the convenience of having your cookout menu items delivered to your doorstep is unbeatable.

If you prefer a more hands-on experience, visiting a local Cookout restaurant is also a great option. The fast-food chain is known for its quick service, and you can often find seasonal promotions and limited-time deals that aren’t available online.

Cookout Offers and Popular Deals 

For those looking to get the most bang for their buck, Cookout offers plenty of deals that cater to families and groups. The Cookout Tray is one of the best offers, but there are also limited-time promotions that feature discounted milkshakes, reduced menu prices for select items, and combo meals that include sides like hushpuppies, fries, or cheese bites.

It’s best to keep an eye on their website for updated deals, as Cookout’s menu often features rotating specials that provide even more value.

Frequently Asked Questions About Cookout

1. What is the best item on the Cookout Menu?

While it varies depending on personal preference, the Big Double Burger and Cookout Tray are two of the most popular items due to their size and value. If you prefer something different, the fancy milkshakes are also highly recommended.

2. What are the most popular milkshake flavors at Cookout?

Some of the best flavors include Oreo, Banana Pudding, and Chocolate Cheesecake. Cookout’s extensive milkshake menu has something for everyone.

3. Does Cookout offer breakfast?

No, Cookout does not currently offer a breakfast menu. However, their all-day offerings of burgers, quesadillas, and hot dogs make it a great option for lunch and dinner.

4. Can I order Cookout for delivery?

Yes, Cookout offers delivery through third-party services like UberEats and DoorDash, making it easy to enjoy your favorite meals at home.

Conclusion

Whether you’re planning a backyard BBQ or just looking for the best deals on your next meal, the Cookout Menu has something for everyone. With its customizable tray menu, delicious milkshakes, and affordable menu prices, Cookout is one of the best fast food chains for value and variety. Be sure to check the updated prices at your local Cookout restaurant, and make your next outdoor feast unforgettable!
